audit.whatIsWrong: Sides read Skill / Volibear x5 / Skill while whys[2], whys[3] and whys[5] under them hand those stages to Darius, and the mirror sets a different chart again.
audit.why: The audited darius__volibear entry fixes the chart at Darius, Darius, Darius, Darius, Volibear, Darius, Skill. Both directions must state the same rows or mirror-fix.js overwrites this page.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 and 5 to Darius, row 4 stays Volibear, row 6 stays Skill; ratings 4,4,4,4,7,4,5. Proposed as matched full/content pairs with whys[0], whys[1], whys[6] and phases[0-3].why, phases[5].why rewritten to support the sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one Darius cooldown appeared in the lane text, and the level-6 spike leaned on a shield Volibear's R does not have.
audit.why: Apprehend's 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s is by far the longest cooldown in his kit and is the actual trade window; Decimate 9/8/7/6/5s and Noxian Guillotine 120/100/80s set the rest of the rhythm.
audit.corrected: Those numbers plus Stormbringer's 160s written into early, mid, late, spikes[1], spikes[3] and the phase whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and late credited Volibear's R with a shield.
audit.why: Stormbringer grants bonus Health, a slow and a tower disable. The shield is Sky Splitter (E, 16s) and only if Volibear is inside his own blast radius — that condition was never stated.
audit.corrected: Shield moved to Sky Splitter with the inside-the-blast condition in spikes[1]; late and spikes[3] rebuilt on Stormbringer's bonus health and The Relentless Storm. Noxian Guillotine's kill-refresh named as the reason a lost fight at first item chains.

edits.before: W start for the bite-trade, or Q into aggressive lanes. Even exchanges favour you because the passive lightning ramps as the trade extends.
edits.after: Decimate (9s at rank 1) heals off its outer blade, so his level 1 beats yours — take the wave and refuse the extended exchange.

edits.before: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out. Darius has to respect every walk-up once your second W heal-bite threatens.
edits.after: Hemorrhage stacks on every hit and enrages him at five. Level 2 is his — trade in bursts, never blow-for-blow.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Darius under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: Level 3 is his: Apprehend (26s at rank 1) pulls you back into range, and Decimate's blade heals him through your Frenzied Maul.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Darius down every time Apprehend (Pull) is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay his as Decimate falls to 6s. Your one clean window is right after Apprehend is spent — its cooldown is the longest in his kit.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Darius to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: First item goes to Darius: Noxian Guillotine refreshes on a kill, so a lost fight there can chain into a lost lane.

edits.before: Level 1 is even — first-blood potential both ways with neither committing.
edits.after: Level 1 is his — Decimate's blade heals him off you before you have a stun.

edits.before: At level 2 your ramping passive and W lets you out-trade before his bleed matters.
edits.after: At level 2 Hemorrhage stacks faster than your Frenzied Maul second bite heals.

edits.before: With 2+ items your R, tankiness and DPS out-scale him past his ult window.
edits.after: With 2+ items it evens — you survive the bleed, he still has the reset.

edits.before: Stormbringer flips the level-6 all-in: leap in, E-slow so he can't reposition his Q blade, and your R shield plus passive shred beats his non-ult burst before Noxian Guillotine (R) is stacked enough to execute.
edits.after: Stormbringer (160s) flips the level-6 all-in: leap in, Sky Splitter to slow and shield yourself — the shield only lands if you stand in your own blast — and kill him before Noxian Guillotine (120s) has stacks to execute with.

edits.before: Late you out-scale — your R re-cast, tankiness, and passive DPS let you survive his bleed window and kill him after Guillotine is on cooldown, so bait the ult then commit.
edits.after: Late it evens — Stormbringer's bonus health and The Relentless Storm's ramp let you survive the bleed window, so bait Noxian Guillotine and commit after it.

edits.before: Level 1-2 is a coin-flip on who lands the first proc, but neither of you has the tools to commit yet, so it stays even.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are his: Decimate (9s) heals off its outer blade and Hemorrhage stacks on every hit — trade in bursts, not blow-for-blow.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 belong to Darius: his Decimate heal, bleed stacks, and E pull win any prolonged trade, so you only fight around his Q cooldown — but your level-6 Stormbringer all-in swings that one window back to you.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 belong to Darius: Decimate heals off its outer blade and Apprehend (26s at rank 1) drags you back, so fight only on that cooldown — your level-6 Stormbringer dive swings the one window back.

edits.before: Through first item his stacked bleed and Guillotine reset out-duel you, but with 2+ items your R shield, tankiness, and passive DPS let you survive the bleed and out-scale him.
edits.after: Through first item his stacked bleed and the Guillotine reset out-duel you, but with two items Stormbringer's bonus health and The Relentless Storm let you survive the bleed.

notes: packet suspectNames flags 'Bait Noxian Guillotine' in wants.you[2] — FALSE POSITIVE, the matcher is tripping on the leading verb; the name is correct per Riot Data Dragon, and I left the line alone. The mirror chart and the packet chart disagree at rows 0, 1 and 6; I followed the mirror because mirror-fix.js enforces it, but the packet's Volibear-at-level-2 reading is defensible and worth a decision — flagged in questionsForUser. Apprehend also passively grants armour penetration, which is why his 'no cooldowns up' state is still dangerous; that is now implicit in the phase text but not stated as a number, since Riot's text gives no percentage.
